thread:
sam: quick flag noisy rollout -- several teams reported dozens of emails when we rolled a tenant-scoped config yesterday. can we design a polite default for staged propagations?

riley: saw it. root cause: every replica emits a `cfg.apply` event and notifier fans out. preview + apply doubled it.

joan: want to avoid changing audit streams. idea: introduce a `notify_policy` enum on propagate requests: `immediate` (today), `quiet_window` (suppress non-critical for a period), `digest` (emit single summary).

nina: `quiet_window` sounds promising: suppress per-node deliveries for N minutes after phase start but still escalate critical errors. teams could choose short windows for fast feedback.

sam: telemetry and UX ask: preview should show `estimated_deliveries` under each policy and a small "notification budget" slider so teams can cap worst-case deliveries. helps on-call decide.

riley: backend implications: add `propagation_id` (uuid) to all events so we can group them, and `notify_policy` + `quiet_window_seconds` in the propagate API. notifier will aggregate by propagation_id.

joan: escalation rules: keep `escalate_on` list (error codes / severities). default preserve P0/P1. also add `notify_safety_breaker` that if failures > X% will immediately emit intermediate digest.

nina: API proposal: POST /v1/configs/:id/propagate?notify_policy=digest&quiet_window_seconds=300&notify_safety_breaker=0.05

sam: example curl for docs:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/configs/42/propagate?notify_policy=digest&quiet_window_seconds=300&notify_safety_breaker=0.05" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"targets": ["tenant:acme"], "stages": [{"pct": 5},{"pct":100}], "propagation_id": "8f7b-..."}'
```

riley: notifier changes: if `notify_policy=digest` produce `cfg.propagation.summary` with fields: propagation_id, phase, total_targets, applied, failed, top_errors (sampled), estimated_notif_count. Also emit `cfg.propagation.intermediate_digest` if safety breaker trips.

joan: console: add a small inline control in the rollout modal: Policy dropdown + "Show estimated deliveries" link. default stays `immediate` for now but product ok to test `digest` for self-serve customers.

nina: telemetry: add `notification_estimate` to preview response, plus `recipient_sample` (small list of recipients) for transparency. retention: keep full audit events but mark them `audit_only=true` so notifier knows not to deliver.

sam: edge-case: long rollouts that span multiple phases. we should emit a phase boundary digest (preview->apply) if notify_policy=digest, so teams see phase-level progress.

riley: agreed. events: `cfg.propagation.phase_boundary` + optional `intermediate_digest`. we'll add `phase` tag. backward compat: notifier will accept events without propagation_id for 7 days and synthesize summaries when possible.

joan: decision summary: implement `notify_policy` (immediate|quiet_window|digest), add `propagation_id`, `quiet_window_seconds`, `notify_safety_breaker`, keep `escalate_on` default list, add preview `notification_estimate`.

nina: next actions: riley to draft proto + notifier change; sam to add API docs + curl; joan to update rollout runbook and set product experiment; priya (assign later) to write console copy.

ops-bot: automated note cfg.propagation.request propagation_id=8f7b user=sam env=prod

sam: thanks all, aim for a small rollout next week and measure reduction in delivered messages. :thumbsup:
